properties.name: triggers
properties.title: Triggers
properties.description: One row for each push button wired between a GPIO pin (BCM number) and ground, and what pressing it does: play, stop, toggle (stop while playing, else play), next (the next page of the playlist), run a task (a Priority Update task, set up on the row, that shows for its minutes) or play a playlist (the playlist layer goes to its first track and carries on from there). Play, stop, toggle and next can each be on one button only. Not a pin the panel uses (the list says which). Changes apply within a few seconds.

properties.name: pin
properties.title: GPIO Pin
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) the button is wired to: the choices follow the display type chosen in Display, and the pins the panel uses are not available.

properties.name: action
properties.title: Action
properties.description: What pressing the button does. A task shows a Priority Update (its settings are set on the row) for its minutes. Play playlist starts the playlist you choose from its first track.

properties.name: playlist
properties.title: Playlist
properties.description: The playlist the button starts: it begins at its first track and carries on from there, through the playlists after it.

properties.name: outputs
properties.title: Outputs
properties.description: One row for each thing the device can say something with: a GPIO output (an LED wired from a pin through a resistor to ground, or an active buzzer; the Inky Impression has an LED on pin 13, at the top centre edge of the board), a haptic motor (a DRV2605 driver on the I²C bus, such as on the Impression's Qw/ST socket) or a sound card (a USB sound stick). A GPIO output with no pin is not connected. Feedback, below, says what each one says and when. An output whose hardware is not found is said in Activity, and the others still work.

properties.name: name
properties.title: Name
properties.description: What the output is called in Feedback and in Buttons, live: LED, Buzzer, Speaker.

properties.name: kind
properties.title: Kind
properties.description: GPIO: an LED or a buzzer on a pin. Haptic: a vibration motor (felt only while touching the device, so for the buttons). Audio: a sound card.

properties.name: pin
properties.title: Pin
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) it is wired to. Empty: not connected. Not a pin the panel, a button or another output uses.

properties.name: speed
properties.title: Speed
properties.description: How long one blink takes, on and off: every cue speeds up or slows down with it, keeping its rhythm. Slower is easier to see from across a room. Test plays three blinks at the speed chosen now, on the saved output.

properties.name: volume
properties.title: Volume
properties.description: How loud the sound card plays the cues.

properties.name: feedback
properties.title: Feedback
properties.description: What the outputs say, and when: one row for each event and output. Press and Long Press play once, when the button is let go; Held plays once a button has been held for a second (the cue that letting go is a long press); Problem while every track of the playlist has failed or the device waits to be set up; Drawing while the panel refreshes. One cue plays at a time on an output: a press plays over the others, Held comes before Problem, and Problem before Drawing. An LED keeps a Steady, Slow, Fast or Heartbeat cue going while the state lasts; a haptic motor and a sound card play a state's cue once, when it begins.

properties.name: output
properties.title: Output
properties.description: Which output says it: one of the saved Outputs (save a new one first).

properties.name: cue
properties.title: Cue
properties.description: What it says. An LED blinks (One, Two, Three), stays lit (Steady) or keeps a rhythm (Slow, Fast, Heartbeat); a haptic motor clicks or buzzes the same counts and rhythms; a sound card plays a tone for each. Test plays it on the saved output now.

properties.name: quietFrom
properties.title: Quiet From
properties.description: The hour (0 to 23, the device's time) every output goes still, for the night; it wakes again at Quiet To. Either empty: never still. A Test still plays.

properties.name: quietTo
properties.title: Quiet To
properties.description: The hour (0 to 23) the outputs wake again after Quiet From: 22 to 7 is still from ten at night to seven in the morning.
